single version across the monorepo (ADR-0018 single-version invariant for DIRECT/catalog deps; consumer-governed TRANSITIVES are not manifest-declared so they are invisible to this group and may legitimately coexist — minimatch multi-versions, etc.)

semverGroups.label: exact ranges only — no ^ ~ * >= on literal specs (ADR-0018). syncpack 15 reads the catalog: protocol, so catalog:/catalog:otel refs are valid instances (IsCatalog) and the CI gate is `syncpack lint`. The dependency types it reads (prod, dev, peer, npm overrides) are passed with --dependency-types, because syncpack 15 rejects the dependencyTypes config key.
